teaser.en: A wild hibiscus with vine-shaped leaves and yellow flowers with a dark heart.
teaser.sw: Hibiscus pori wenye majani ya umbo la majani ya mzabibu na maua ya manjano yenye kiini cheusi.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa *Hibiscus* wa weruni wenye makodza dza ga mzabibu, na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye kahi-kahi nyiru.

summary.en: Mwejenje is a wild hibiscus close to Hibiscus vitifolius, the tropical rose mallow. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mwejenje ni hibiscus pori anayekaribiana na Hibiscus vitifolius (*tropical rose mallow*). Pakia anaripoti jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mwejenje* ni *Hibiscus* ya weruni inayohalana sana na *Hibiscus vitifolius*, ambayo kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tropical rose mallow*. Pakia kaandika chitu chanjina kuriko dzinare ra Chidigo.

about.en: Pakia identified Mwejenje as a Hibiscus similar to H. vitifolius, but not certainly that species. Hibiscus vitifolius is a hairy, shrubby herb, usually 1 to 2 m tall, with leaves lobed like a grapevine's (hence vitifolius). Its large flowers are pale yellow with a deep maroon centre, and its fruits are five-winged, hairy capsules.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mwejenje kama Hibiscus inayofanana na H. vitifolius, ingawa si kwa uhakika kuwa ni spishi hiyo. Hibiscus vitifolius ni mmea wa kichaka wenye manyoya, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 2, na majani yenye ndewe kama ya mzabibu (ndiyo maana ya vitifolius). Maua yake makubwa ni ya manjano hafifu yenye kiini cha rangi ya maruni iliyokolea, na matunda yake ni vifuko vyenye manyoya na mabawa matano.
about.dg: Pakia wagomba kukala *Mwejenje* ni *Hibiscus* inayohalana na *H. vitifolius*, ela kaweza kugomba kpwa hakika kukala ni aina ihiyo hasa. *Hibiscus vitifolius* ni mmea wenye nyere, dza chitsaka chidide, kpwa kawaida wa urefu wa mita 1 hadi 2. Makodzage gana mala dza makodza ga mzabibu (ndiyo mana unaihwa *vitifolius*). Maruwage ni makulu, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na kahi-kahi yakpwe ni ya rangi ya kundu-nyiru; matundage ni makakaya genye nyere na mapha matsano.

where.en: Plants of this kind grow in bushland, grassland, forest edges and old farmland.
where.sw: Mimea ya aina hii huota vichakani, nyikani, pembezoni mwa misitu na kwenye mashamba ya zamani.
where.dg: Mimea ya aina ihi inamera weruni, phatu pha nyasi, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye minda ya kare.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwejenje but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is given as Hibiscus sp. aff. vitifolius, meaning a Hibiscus close to H. vitifolius.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwejenje lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi limetolewa kama Hibiscus sp. aff. vitifolius, yaani Hibiscus inayokaribiana na H. vitifolius.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mwejenje*, ela kalavya manage, wala madzina ganayohumirwa piya ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hibiscus* sp. aff. *vitifolius*, ichimaanisha *Hibiscus* inayohalana na *H. vitifolius*.
